ranks: The need-keys recheck list R8 (Phase 1 step 2)

blocked.name: The Sound of Drums
blocked.why: 'If enchanted creature would deal combat damage to a permanent or player, it deals double that damage instead': the damage replacement's source filter can't name this Aura's host.

blocked.name: Tor Wauki the Younger
blocked.why: 'If another source you control would deal noncombat damage …, it deals that much damage plus 1': the +N damage replacement can't leave out its own source.

blocked.name: Undead Alchemist
blocked.why: 'If a Zombie you control would deal combat damage to a player, instead that player mills that many cards': no replacement turns the damage into the damaged player milling.

blocked.name: With Great Power . . .
blocked.why: 'All damage that would be dealt to you is dealt to enchanted creature instead' is a standing redirection, and '+2/+2 for each Aura and Equipment attached to it' counts what's attached to the affected creature.

blocked.name: Containment Priest
blocked.why: 'If a nontoken creature would enter and it wasn't cast, exile it instead': no entry replacement redirects another permanent to exile, and none asks how it got there.

blocked.name: Cosmic Intervention
blocked.why: A turn-long 'your permanents that would die are exiled instead' replacement with each exiled card returned at the next end step.

blocked.name: Nemata, Primeval Warden
blocked.why: 'If a creature an opponent controls would die, exile it instead. When you do, create a 1/1 Saproling': the exile replacement has no reflexive trigger per replaced event (tokens included).

blocked.name: Alms Collector
blocked.why: 'If an opponent would draw two or more cards, instead you and that player each draw a card': would-draw sees single draws, not an instruction's count, and can't have both players draw.

blocked.name: Out of the Tombs
blocked.why: An empty-library draw replaced by returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield, or losing the game if you can't.

blocked.name: Urabrask, Heretic Praetor
blocked.why: 'The next time they would draw a card this turn, instead they exile the top card of their library. They may play it this turn' — a one-shot draw replacement on an opponent.

blocked.name: Consulate Surveillance
blocked.why: 'Prevent all damage that would be dealt to you this turn by a source of your choice': prevent-damage-from-chosen-source takes only next-time or a fixed amount.

blocked.name: Deflecting Palm
blocked.why: 'If damage is prevented this way, Deflecting Palm deals that much damage to that source's controller': the prevention's follow-up can't reach the chosen source's controller.

blocked.name: Shadowbane
blocked.why: One chosen-source shield over you and/or creatures you control, and life gain only when the source was black.

blocked.name: River Song's Diary
blocked.why: Every player's instant and sorcery spells cast from hand exiled as they resolve and linked to the artifact, then a random one of those cards cast free.

blocked.name: Academy Manufactor
blocked.why: 'If you would create a Clue, Food, or Treasure token, instead create one of each': the token replacement only multiplies, adds that many, or substitutes one named token.

blocked.name: Moonlit Meditation
blocked.why: 'The first time you would create one or more tokens each turn, you may instead create that many tokens that are copies of enchanted permanent.'

blocked.name: Queen Allenal of Ruadach
blocked.why: 'Those tokens plus a 1/1 white Soldier creature token': plusTokens adds that many, not one, and can't be limited to creature tokens.

blocked.name: Quina, Qu Gourmet
blocked.why: 'Those tokens plus a 1/1 green Frog creature token': plusTokens adds that many, not one.

blocked.name: Worldwalker Helm
blocked.why: 'If you would create one or more artifact tokens, instead create those tokens plus an additional Map token': one extra, only for artifact tokens.

blocked.name: Xorn
blocked.why: 'If you would create one or more Treasure tokens, instead create those tokens plus an additional Treasure token': one extra, only for Treasures.

blocked.name: Mana Sculpt
blocked.why: The countered spell's mana spent, read at your next main phase: manaSpentOf of a target spell that left the stack reads nothing.

blocked.name: Admiral Beckett Brass
blocked.why: A per-player count of the Pirates that dealt them combat damage this turn, as a target restriction.

blocked.name: Gollum, Obsessed Stalker
blocked.why: 'Each opponent dealt combat damage this game by a creature named Gollum, Obsessed Stalker' has no player scope.

blocked.name: Hope of Ghirapur
blocked.why: 'Target player who was dealt combat damage by Hope of Ghirapur this turn': no player-target filter on damage this source dealt.

blocked.name: Rith, Liberated Primeval
blocked.why: An end-step check for excess damage dealt this turn to an opponent's creature or planeswalker, including ones that have since died.

blocked.name: Tangled Colony
blocked.why: 'X is the amount of damage dealt to it this turn': no amount reads the damage dealt to a creature this turn.

blocked.name: Sentinel Tower
blocked.why: 'The number of instant and sorcery spells cast before that spell this turn': the count must be the one as of the triggering spell, any player's.

blocked.name: Archive Trap
blocked.why: No turn record of an opponent having searched their library, for the {0} alternative cost.

blocked.name: Blitzball
blocked.why: 'Activate only if an opponent was dealt combat damage by a legendary creature this turn.'

blocked.name: Magus of the Moon
blocked.why: 'Nonbasic lands are Mountains' sets their land type and removes their other abilities (rule 305.7).

blocked.name: Baird, Steward of Argive
blocked.why: 'Creatures can't attack you or planeswalkers you control unless their controller pays {1} for each': attackTax covers only the player.

blocked.name: Bloodthirster
blocked.why: 'This creature can't attack a player it has already attacked this turn.'

blocked.name: Legion Loyalist
blocked.why: Battalion's 'creatures you control … can't be blocked by creature tokens this turn': no until-end-of-turn can't-be-blocked-by grant.

blocked.name: Master of Cruelties
blocked.why: 'This creature can only attack alone' has no restriction (its other abilities are expressible).

blocked.name: Mirri, Weatherlight Duelist
blocked.why: 'No more than one creature can attack you each combat' while tapped, and 'each opponent can't block with more than one creature this combat'.

blocked.name: Stormtide Leviathan
blocked.why: 'Creatures without flying or islandwalk can't attack' — a restriction over creatures lacking either of two keywords.

blocked.name: Toby, Beastie Befriender
blocked.why: The Beast token's 'This token can't attack or block alone' has no restriction.

blocked.name: Troll of Khazad-dûm
blocked.why: 'This creature can't be blocked except by three or more creatures.'

blocked.name: Cloudspire Coordinator
blocked.why: 'The number of Mounts and/or Vehicles that entered the battlefield under your control this turn', counted as they entered.

blocked.name: Valor's Flagship
blocked.why: Cycling {X}{2}{W}, and 'when you cycle this card, create X Pilot tokens'.

blocked.name: Bind the Monster
blocked.why: 'It deals damage to you equal to its power': the enchanted creature as the damage source.

blocked.name: Meekstone
blocked.why: 'Creatures with power 3 or greater don't untap': a static's affects filter can't read power inside the characteristics fold.

blocked.name: Master Chef
blocked.why: 'Commander creatures you own have' two enters-with-counter replacements: a static can't grant a replacement ability.

blocked.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn
blocked.why: 'Creature spells you cast have convoke' (and the back face's 'each other nontoken creature you control has persist').

blocked.name: Rivaz of the Claw
blocked.why: 'It gains "When this creature dies, exile it"': an ability granted to a creature spell as it's cast from the graveyard, kept by the permanent it becomes.

blocked.name: Wand of the Worldsoul
blocked.why: '{T}: The next spell you cast this turn has convoke.'

blocked.name: Liliana's Talent
blocked.why: 'Whenever a creature deals damage to enchanted planeswalker, destroy that creature': the trigger can't name the enchanted planeswalker as the recipient (the granted [−8] is built).

blocked.name: Biotransference
blocked.why: Creatures you control are artifacts, and so are creature spells you control and creature cards you own outside the battlefield.

blocked.name: Conspiracy
blocked.why: The chosen creature type for creature spells and creature cards you own outside the battlefield (set, not added).

blocked.name: Dune Chanter
blocked.why: Land cards you own outside the battlefield are Deserts in addition to their other types.

blocked.name: Arcane Adaptation
blocked.why: The chosen creature type added to creature spells you control and creature cards you own outside the battlefield.

blocked.name: Rukarumel, Biologist
blocked.why: The chosen type added to Slivers and nontoken creatures, and to creature spells and creature cards you own outside the battlefield.

blocked.name: Gemcutter Buccaneer
blocked.why: Treasures becoming Equipment with granted equip abilities (equip Pirate {1}, equip {3}) and a granted 'Equipped creature gets +2/+0'.

blocked.name: Mirror Box
blocked.why: '+1/+1 for each other creature you control with the same name as that creature' (the legend-rule exemption is built).

blocked.name: Platinum Emperion
blocked.why: 'Your life total can't change' as a static on a permanent.

blocked.name: Anvil of Bogardan
blocked.why: 'Players have no maximum hand size': noMaxHandSize applies only to its controller.

blocked.name: Enter the Infinite
blocked.why: 'You have no maximum hand size until your next turn' as a one-shot effect.

blocked.name: Folio of Fancies
blocked.why: 'Players have no maximum hand size': noMaxHandSize applies only to its controller.

blocked.name: Nerd Rage
blocked.why: A granted 'You have no maximum hand size' read for the enchanted creature's controller.

blocked.name: Praetor's Counsel
blocked.why: 'You have no maximum hand size for the rest of the game.'

blocked.name: The Second Doctor
blocked.why: 'Players have no maximum hand size', and 'each opponent who does can't attack you or permanents you control during their next turn'.

blocked.name: Elturel Survivors
blocked.why: '+X/+0, where X is the number of lands defending player controls' while attacking.

blocked.name: Kyler, Sigardian Emissary
blocked.why: '+1/+1 for each counter on Kyler' counts every kind; countersOnSource takes one.

blocked.name: Sliver Legion
blocked.why: '+1/+1 for each other Sliver on the battlefield', other than each affected Sliver.

blocked.name: Aettir and Priwen
blocked.why: 'Equipped creature has base power and toughness X/X, where X is your life total.'

blocked.name: Gandalf the White
blocked.why: The trigger doubler for a legendary permanent or artifact leaving the battlefield (entering and the flash grant are expressible).

blocked.name: Hushbringer
blocked.why: 'Creatures entering or dying don't cause abilities to trigger.'

blocked.name: Sanctum of All
blocked.why: 'If a triggered ability of another Shrine you control triggers': doubleTriggersOf has no exclusion of this permanent (the library-and/or-graveyard search and the six-Shrines condition are expressible).

blocked.name: The Masamune
blocked.why: The equipped creature's granted dies-trigger doubling (for its own abilities and your emblems).

blocked.name: Twinflame Travelers
blocked.why: 'A triggered ability of another Elemental you control': doubleTriggersOf has no exclusion of this permanent.

blocked.name: Wizard's Staff
blocked.why: 'If a triggered ability of equipped creature triggers, that ability triggers an additional time.'

blocked.name: Wulfgar of Icewind Dale
blocked.why: 'A creature you control attacking' as the doubler's cause.

blocked.name: Elrond, Moon-Reader
blocked.why: 'Whenever you activate an ability of a creature' counts mana abilities too (its ruling), once each turn.

blocked.name: Haunting Wind
blocked.why: Any player's artifact ability activated without {T} in its cost, as a trigger.

blocked.name: Neerdiv, Devious Diver
blocked.why: 'Or activate an ability of a card in your graveyard' as a trigger.

blocked.name: Way of the Mind Sculptor
blocked.why: A loyalty-activation trigger gated on its cost removing two or more counters.

blocked.name: Kira, Great Glass-Spinner
blocked.why: 'For the first time each turn' counted over all players' spells and abilities, per creature.

blocked.name: Unsettled Mariner
blocked.why: 'Whenever you … becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls': becomes-target fires only for permanents.

blocked.name: Shadow of the Goblin
blocked.why: 'Whenever you play a land … from anywhere other than your hand': plays-card has from but no not-from.

blocked.name: The Lost and the Damned
blocked.why: 'A land you control enters from anywhere other than your hand' (token lands included) or 'you cast a spell from anywhere other than your hand'.

blocked.name: Aurora Phoenix
blocked.why: 'Whenever you cast a spell with cascade.'

blocked.name: Virtual Assistant
blocked.why: 'Whenever you cast a spell using teamwork': `kicked` would match kicked spells too.

blocked.name: Breeches, Brazen Plunderer
blocked.why: One trigger over every opponent the Pirates damaged, exiling from each of their libraries.

blocked.name: Bitter Work
blocked.why: 'Whenever you attack a player with one or more creatures with power 4 or greater, draw a card' — once per player attacked (the ruling), with a filter on the attackers: attack-with fires once per declaration and attacks-player has no attacker filter.
